text:
Ɛfiri 8 kɔsi 29 June 1958 no, Sweden bɛyɛɛ Nordic ne Scandinavian ɔman a edi kan a ɔtoo Wiase Kup, ɛmaa kuw 16 aba amateur bere mu, TV ansa na aba no mu wɔ Europe bɔɔl a ɛwɔ 1950s n’akyi. Finals no kɔɔ Sweden kuropɔn 12 mu, na wɔakyerɛ sɛ nnipa 819,810 na wɔbaa matches 35 no mu, na ɛyɛ 23,400 wɔ game biara mu. Nhyehyɛe no hyɛɛ ase sɛ kuw anan a ɛwɔ kuw anan mu, ɛyɛ round-robin baako a wɔde points 2 ma nkunimdie na 1 ma draw, na wɔde playoffs si nkitaho a ɛwɔ qualification mu, ansa na wɔakɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match ne final a ɛyɛ single-elimination.

Wiase Kup no daa Wales, Northern Ireland ne Soviet Union adi, na ɛyɛɛ goalless draw a edi kan wɔ Wiase Kup abakɔsɛm mu. Nsɛm a ɛda no adi paa ne sɛ Pele a wadi mfe 17 no daa ne ho adi sɛ ɔsram a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ abofra a odi kan a ɔtoo bɔɔl wɔ Wiase Kup final mu na ɔdii nkunim. France Just Fontaine nso too bɔɔl 13 wɔ edition no mu, ɛyɛ record a ɛwɔ tournament baako mu a ɛda so ara; ɔtoo bɔɔl anan wɔ France 6-3 nkunimdie a wɔdii West Germany wɔ third-place match a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Gothenburg, na ɔmaa ne kuw dii mprenu so.

Final a wɔbɔɔ wɔ Rasunda Stadium wɔ Solna a ɛwɔ Stockholm kɛse no mu no, ɛne Brazil ne hosts no na wɔbɔɔ. Sweden dii kan denam Nils Liedholm so, nanso Brazil san dii mu kɔɔ 2-1 wɔ half-time mu na wɔtwee kɔɔ nkunim 5-2 a extra time nni mu. Vava ne Pele too bɔɔl mmienu mmienu na Mario Zagalo too bɔɔl a ɛto so anum, na Agne Simonsson nso too Sweden bɔɔl a ɛto so abien. Nsɛm no maa Brazil dii Wiase Kup a edi kan, Sweden nso yɛɛ runners-up, na ɛmaa Brazil yɛɛ ɔman a ɛnyɛ Europe de a edi kan a ɔdii Wiase Kup a wɔtoo wɔ Europe.
